title: Akka core jar still under BSL 1.1 on this date
why: Akka 2.7.0 and later ship under the Business Source License 1.1. Each release converts to Apache 2.0 only on its own Change Date, printed in that release's LICENSE file. Production use before that date needs a commercial Akka licence unless a grant applies.
fix: Replace com.typesafe.akka with org.apache.pekko and akka-* with pekko-* (Pekko 1.x, Apache 2.0).
source: LICENSE files in github.com/akka/akka at tags v2.8.0, v2.8.8, v2.9.0, v2.9.5, v2.10.0

title: Akka core jar under BSL, Change Date not proven for this exact release
why: Patch releases carry their own Change Date, three years after that release. Akka 2.8.0 turned Apache 2.0 on 2026-03-16 but Akka 2.8.8 stays BSL until 2027-10-28. The 2.7.x LICENSE says 'TBD (3 years after 2.7.0 release)'.
fix: Read the LICENSE inside the exact jar version, or move to org.apache.pekko.

title: This exact Akka release has passed its Change Date
why: On its Change Date the release converts to Apache 2.0. Any later patch you upgrade to is BSL again.
fix: Pin this exact version, or move to org.apache.pekko before you upgrade.

title: Akka module on a BSL release line
why: The Akka 22.10 release moved these modules to BSL 1.1: Akka HTTP 10.4.0, Akka gRPC 2.2.0, Akka Management 1.2.0, Alpakka Kafka 4.0.0, Alpakka 5.0.0, Akka Persistence R2DBC 1.0.0, Akka Persistence JDBC 5.2.0, Akka Persistence Cassandra 1.1.0, Akka Projections 1.3.0.
fix: Use the Apache Pekko module named in the message.

title: Akka and Pekko jars in the same build
why: A half-finished move keeps the BSL jars on the classpath and runs two actor toolkits side by side.
fix: Finish the swap: no com.typesafe.akka or com.lightbend.akka coordinates left.

title: akka.* config key that Pekko never reads
why: Pekko reads its settings from the pekko.* namespace. An akka { } block is silently ignored, so settings such as actor.provider = cluster fall back to defaults.
fix: Rename the root key from akka to pekko.

title: akka:// address that a default Pekko node refuses
why: pekko.remote.protocol-name defaults to pekko and accept-protocol-names defaults to ["pekko"].
fix: Write pekko://, or during a rolling move set pekko.remote.accept-protocol-names = ["akka", "pekko"].

title: Akka default remoting port
why: Akka defaults to 25520 (Artery) and 2552 (classic). Pekko defaults to 17355 (Artery) and 7355 (classic), so a node that relied on the default listens on a different port after the swap.
fix: Set pekko.remote.artery.canonical.port explicitly, or change the seed address to 17355.

title: import akka.* in source
why: Pekko classes live under org.apache.pekko; import akka.* will not compile once the Akka jars are gone.
